title: Older-footage compression
description: Preserve original quality for the configured capture age, then compress eligible recordings once using your selected encoder and target variable bitrate. Original resolution is preserved. Original cadence is retained unless fixed-rate normalization is explicitly configured.
safety: Saved evidence and active readers are excluded. Verified smaller output replaces the eligible original. A temporary original backup is removed only after atomic commit and a durable recovery journal; unfinished cleanup reports no reclaimed bytes and blocks further work. Encoder failures never silently switch codec or hardware. Changing settings never automatically recompresses completed files. Pause waits for the current file; Stop cancels before publication.
encoderHelp: NVIDIA options require hardware support for the selected codec. The RTX A400 supports H.264 and H.265 encoding, not AV1 encoding. Choose a CPU AV1 encoder on that card. CPU jobs use only the configured available logical CPU cores; this is not a reservation of those cores.
frameRateHelp: Leave the frame rate blank to require the original constant cadence; variable-timed recordings will be skipped. Setting a frame rate explicitly permits frame duplication or dropping to produce constant cadence. This is a lossy conversion, not a claim of unchanged original frames.
invalidEncoder: Choose one of the supported compression encoders.
localOnly: This version compresses local recordings only. Archived recordings are not modified.
archiveHelp: Local and NAS archive recordings are supported. Archive writes require the verified original mount and owned durable staging reservations; playback links and capture dates remain unchanged.
readerGate: Compression is blocked until all original-media readers are certified to hold renewable recording leases.
recoveryGate: Unresolved recovery journals block new compression. An administrator must inspect retained originals and recovery data before reactivation.
reservationGate: Compression is blocked until the durable storage reservation ownership migration is installed.
unavailable: Compression is unavailable. No new job can be started.

fields.enabled: Enable compression (does not start a manual batch)
fields.frame_rate: Fixed output FPS (blank keeps original cadence)
fields.weekly: Automatically start one bounded batch per weekly UTC window

weeklyHelp: Disabled by default. Enabling this option authorizes weekly automatic batches. Jobs do not resume automatically after a restart. The capture-age minimum is never overridden by a quota or maintenance window.
actionFailed: Could not change compression job. Refresh and check its current state.
counts: {{processed}} / {{max_files}} files processed; {{compressed}} compressed, {{skipped}} skipped, {{failed}} failed; {{saved_bytes}} media allocation bytes reclaimed after verified backup cleanup
savingsHelp: Savings are counted only after temporary media copies are removed. Filesystem block allocation is used when available. NAS snapshots, server-side deduplication, audit metadata and concurrent recording writes can make the filesystem free-space change differ from this media-allocation reduction.
jobPolicy: This batch uses {{encoder}} at {{bitrate}} Mbps after {{days}} days. Settings changes apply to new batches only.
unknownReason: See administrator audit and recovery records
confirmDescription: This starts one bounded batch using the saved settings, not any unsaved edits above. Eligible unprotected local and archived originals are replaced only after validation. Temporary original backups are removed after durable commit to reclaim space. This is a lossy video conversion and is not an audio repair.

itemState.failed: Failed; original or recovery backup retained

status.interrupted: Interrupted; start a new batch after recovery

reasons.already-compressed: Already compressed; policy changes do not recompress this recording
reasons.too-young: Original quality lifetime has not elapsed
reasons.not-smaller: Output was not smaller; original retained
reasons.no-allocation-savings: Output would not reduce allocated storage; original retained
reasons.storage-reserved: Another storage operation owns this recording
reasons.restart-requires-new-batch: Restart interrupted this job; a new batch is required
reasons.recovery-completed-new-batch-required: Recovery and owned backup cleanup completed; start a new batch to process any remaining recordings
reasons.conversion-failed-original-retained: Conversion or validation failed; original retained
reasons.variable-frame-rate: Original cadence is not constant; explicitly configure a fixed output frame rate to allow normalization
reasons.cpu-affinity-unavailable: The configured CPU limit cannot be enforced; no encoding was started
reasons.batch-failed: Batch failed; originals and journals retained
